title: Wawel Cathedral
visualBrief: Individual Wawel cathedral exterior with pale west gable/rose and portico, separate green clock/Sigismund and brick Silver Bells towers, steep nave/transept/choir roofs, dark Vasa/gold Sigismund domed chapels and connected northern treasury/chapterhouse. The existing royal palace remains a separate asset.

sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Main35m roof,22m lower choir,12m west chapels and45m north crown retained as nominal map heights. South55m cap conflicts with pictures/named Silver Bells crypt; use36m lower component for that crown. Northern Sigismund41m and all intermediate roof/drum/gable splits are estimates. Exact heights unverified.
